provenance.source: Skatteloven; Stortingets skattevedtak for 2026; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Norway (reviewed 20 January 2026); regjeringen.no skattesatser 2026
provenance.notes: The 22% flat rate and the five trinnskatt steps came from PwC. The personfradrag of NOK 114,540, the minstefradrag of 46% capped at NOK 95,700 and the trygdeavgift of 7.6% came from Norwegian budget summaries read on 31 August 2026.

verificationTodo: Confirm the personfradrag, the minstefradrag maximum and the trygdeavgift rate with Skatteetaten.
Confirm that trygdeavgift is charged on gross personal income with no upper limit.
omissions: The low-income tapering of trygdeavgift, under which the contribution may not exceed a share of income above a floor, is not modelled.
Deductions for union dues, travel to work, BSU savings and pension contributions are not modelled.
The finnmarksfradrag for residents of Northern Norway is not modelled.
Wealth tax is out of scope.

generalIncome.note: A flat 22% on alminnelig inntekt, which is income after the minimum standard deduction and the personal allowance. The progressivity comes entirely from the bracket tax charged separately on top.

minstefradrag.note: A standard deduction of 46% of employment income, capped. You may claim actual expenses instead if they are higher, which this app does not model.

personfradrag.note: A personal allowance deducted from alminnelig inntekt before the 22% rate.

trinnskatt.note: Charged on gross personal income, with NO deduction for the minstefradrag or the personfradrag. That is why the Norwegian marginal rate rises faster than the 22% flat rate suggests.

trygdeavgift.note: The employee national insurance contribution, charged on gross personal income. It was reduced by 0.1 points for 2026.

regions.name: Norway
regions.note: Municipal and county tax are collected inside the 22% rate on general income, so there is no separate regional choice here. Northern Norway has a special deduction that is not modelled.

inputSchema.label: Bruttolonn (per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross monthly pay. Norwegian bracket tax is charged on this figure directly, with no deductions, while the 22% tax is charged on income after deductions.

inputSchema.label: Forskuddstrekk (per month)
inputSchema.help: Tax withheld each month, for the annual comparison. Norway withholds nothing in one month of the year and half in another, so a monthly grid reflects that.
